bug_report: under2camel mangles our acronyms. 'http_response' becomes 'HttpResponse' instead of 'HTTPResponse', so generated class names don't match our code style. Make under2camel keep the project's known acronyms uppercase. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

conversations.text: The code generator produces class names like 'HttpResponse' and 'ApiKey' from snake_case, but our codebase style is 'HTTPResponse', 'APIKey'. under2camel is title-casing the acronyms. Can you fix it to keep our acronyms uppercase?
under2camel just capitalizes each underscore-separated part, so 'http' -> 'Http'. I can special-case acronyms. Which ones does your style guide list?
HTTP, HTTPS, URL, API, IO, and ID. Those stay all-caps. Everything else title-cases normally.

Got it — a known-acronym set {HTTP, HTTPS, URL, API, IO, ID}; if a part matches, emit it uppercase, otherwise capitalize as before. So 'user_id' -> 'UserID', 'parse_url' -> 'ParseURL', 'user_name' -> 'UserName'.
